label: HYPERLIQUID_NATIVE_C13_PREREGISTERED_DECISION_GRADE_VALIDATION
provenance_caveat: Real Hyperliquid-native, node-derived (Ironflow HF, CC BY 4.0), NOT venue candleSnapshot. Real fetched/archived candles, non-synthetic. 283d window 2025-12-20T00:00:00Z–2026-09-28T23:00:00Z.

hypotheses.description: Validate or falsify the C12 in-sample lead (RSI(21) crash threshold 25, long target 9%) on Hyperliquid-native evidence with dependence-aware inference.
hypotheses.origin_note: C12 discovery only (c12_25_9: 17 trades / 10 episodes / 11 crash days, total +23,244.22; episode-block bootstrap CI95 spans 0). Hypothesis-generating, NOT a validated GO.

inference_plan.power: Minimum heavy-compute floor: 100 permutation draws and 100 placebo subsets. Minimum effective sample for any GO claim: 10 trades, 5 episodes, 5 distinct crash days. The C12 lead has 17 trades / 10 episodes / 11 crash days on a 283d native window, which is structurally underpowered.
inference_plan.honest_power_handling: Report effective N, episodes, crash days, CI95, permutation p and placebo p for every claim. Label underpowered when criteria are unmet. Never claim GO from point PnL, hedge-masked totals, in-sample discovery, or a CI that spans 0.
inference_plan.lead_config_selection_rule: The lead is fixed by this prereg (rsi 25 / target 9). Do not switch configs after seeing C13 results; a new config requires a new prereg and a new stem.

decision_rules.go: GO only if the pre-registered dependence-aware criteria all hold: episode-block bootstrap CI95 for spot or total excludes 0 with effective N >= 10 trades / 5 episodes / 5 crash days, AND config-matched permutation p < 0.05, AND config-matched placebo p_ge_canonical < 0.05, AND the result is not hedge-masked (spot leg reported separately).
no_go: CI95 spans 0 for spot and total
positive total is entirely hedge/rebound-masked with negative spot
effective sample below the pre-registered floor
insufficient: Effective sample below floor: label UNDERPOWERED / FRAGILE_NOT_DECISION_GRADE
Artifacts missing seed/SHA binding or generated before this prereg
decision_rules.stop_go: Canonical RSI(21)<20 stays NO_GO unless re-validated under a new prereg. A C13 NO_GO/UNDERPOWERED result preserves canonical NO_GO.

runner.notes: Both runners must be invoked with --rsi-threshold 25 --target-pct 9 and the C12 lead census/campaign paths. Each writes a config block with config_matched=true and records seed + campaign/census SHA256. Do not overwrite canonical artifacts.
